_note: Starting values from docs/brief.md, to be tuned on real data. Adding a category = adding an entry here and a row in the categories table (seed).

ROADS.name: Roads
ROADS.photoPrompt: Decide whether this photo shows damage to a road or footpath: a visible hole, crack or broken surface. Selfies, screenshots, indoor photos and intact roads are not valid. If the photo clearly shows a different civic problem (garbage, streetlight), suggest that category instead of INVALID. If unsure, answer UNCERTAIN.
valid: visible hole (pothole) on a road or footpath
riskFactors: size and depth of the damage

valid: same spot with a level, repaired surface

GARBAGE.name: Garbage
GARBAGE.photoPrompt: Decide whether this photo shows uncollected waste, an overflowing bin or a dumping spot in a public area. Selfies, screenshots and indoor photos are not valid. If the photo clearly shows a different civic problem (road damage, streetlight), suggest that category instead of INVALID. If unsure, answer UNCERTAIN.
valid: uncollected waste in a public area
riskFactors: near a market, school or hospital
notes: Garbage reappears quickly, so a repeat report at the same spot is not automatically blamed on the assignee.

STREETLIGHT.name: Streetlight
STREETLIGHT.photoPrompt: Decide whether this photo shows a dark, flickering, hanging or damaged street lamp or pole. Selfies, screenshots and indoor photos are not valid. If the photo clearly shows a different civic problem (road damage, garbage), suggest that category instead of INVALID. A daytime photo may not show whether the lamp works; then answer UNCERTAIN.

valid: same pole with a working lamp (night photo best)

notes: Duplicate radius is about one pole.
If the repair photo is taken in daytime and the AI is UNCERTAIN, the admin decides.
